description: This file defines a migration class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 5.5.0. It contains methods to set up database tables, insert language strings, configure menu items, and manage workflow states related to claims and expenses. It is part of a structured migration system for updating the database schema and application configuration during software updates.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: This class manages the database migration process for version 5.5.0, including creating and modifying tables, inserting language strings and permissions, configuring workflow states, and setting up UI menu items related to claims and expenses.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Main method executing the migration steps: creating tables, inserting data, modifying schema, configuring workflows, and setting up UI components.

methods.name: modifyClaimTables
methods.description: Alters existing claim-related tables to ensure proper character set and data types.

methods.name: modifyClaimRequestCurrencyToForeignKey
methods.description: Converts the currency column in claim requests to a foreign key relation.

methods.name: changeClaimExpenseTypeTableStatusToBoolean
methods.description: Updates the expense type table to store status as boolean values.

methods.name: changeClaimEventTableStatusToBoolean
methods.description: Updates the claim event table to store status as boolean values.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of this migration, '5.5.0'.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version number for language string records.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of LangStringHelper for language string operations.

methods.name: insertMenuItems
methods.description: Helper method to insert menu items into the navigation structure.

methods.name: getParentId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a parent menu item given its title and parent ID.

methods.name: getScreenId
methods.description: Fetches the ID of a screen by its name.

methods.name: checkClaimExists
methods.description: Checks if a claim menu item already exists.

methods.name: cleanClaimScreens
methods.description: Removes obsolete claim-related screens based on predefined names.

methods.name: insertWorkflowState
methods.description: Inserts a workflow state transition into the flow.

methods.name: deleteClaimWorkflowStates
methods.description: Removes existing claim workflow states prior to inserting new ones.

methods.name: removeMarketplaceTables
methods.description: Drops marketplace-related tables if they exist.

methods.name: updateI18nGroups
methods.description: Updates language string groups for internationalization purposes.
